picks.title: Pramaana Labs raises $27M seed round from Khosla Ventures to bring formal verification to AI
picks.why_it_matters: A $27M seed signals strong conviction in AI reliability/safety infrastructure, and formal verification for high-stakes verticals (law, pharma, tax) could become essential middleware as enterprises demand accountable AI outputs.

picks.title: World model maker Odyssey nabs $1.45B valuation backed by Amazon and other big names
picks.why_it_matters: World models represent the next frontier beyond LLMs for robotics and simulation—this mega-round validates the category and signals where strategic corporate capital sees the next platform shift.

picks.title: Collecting robot training data is dirty, unglamorous work. Some AI labs are already paying XDOF to do it.
picks.why_it_matters: Physical AI's data bottleneck is creating a new picks-and-shovels opportunity—startups solving robotics data collection at scale could become critical infrastructure as embodied AI investment accelerates.
